verdict.rationale: xAI's own docs confirm image understanding: some models accept images as input and use the image context in their responses. That is a real first-party capability for this story, but the evidence is a single thin mention limited to the API and to 'some models'. Nothing shows knowledge-workers sharing screenshots or photos in the Grok app, and nothing verifies how accurate the interpretation is. Missing for 10: evidence that screenshots and photos can be uploaded in the consumer or business Grok chat, which models support image input, any limits on image types or formats, and independent or hands-on corroboration of interpretation accuracy.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can share screenshots and photos and have the assistant accurately interpret what is in them

citations.quote: Some models allow images in the input. The model will consider the image context when generating the response.
